objectClass.notes: The reference shows one premium stylized apple from a three-quarter view; the companion concept sheet supplies side and near-top evidence. The target is a real-time mobile-game collectible exported as GLB, not a photoreal scan.

reasoning: The fruit body is a continuous sculpt with a five-lobed crown and base, not a scaled sphere.
The thick stem and folded leaf are separately attached silhouette components.
Reference fidelity depends on broad shape, cavity depth, regional color variation, waxy roughness variation, and sparse integrated speckles rather than dense geometry.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Moderate depth is required because the object has only three macro parts but relies on two radial/repeated systems and several localized material/form overrides to avoid reading as a generic red sphere.

unknownsToResolveBeforeImplementation.note: The back surface is not shown close-up; continue the same restrained speckle and roughness distribution without inventing new markings.
The bottom is partially hidden by the ground shadow. Preserve the visible five-point base indentation but keep it shallow enough for stable physics contact.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

details.description: Deep five-way crown cavity around the stem socket
Five broad asymmetric shoulder lobes that interrupt the upper silhouette
Narrower lower third terminating in a soft five-point base indentation
Broad coral-red blush across the lit shoulder and cheek, blended into crimson skin
Broad soft waxy highlight broken by medium roughness, never a hard plastic hotspot
Sparse, low-contrast shallow fruit-skin lenticels integrated into the surface
Thick curved stem with taper, faceted cut top, and restrained vertical wood grain
Leaf with real thickness, central fold, raised vein, and a curled tapered tip

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

definitionOfDone: At the fixed game-like three-quarter camera the apple reads as a premium five-lobed apple, not a sphere or pumpkin.
The top cavity remains clearly recessed, while the lower third tapers into a stable soft five-point base.
The curved stem is visibly embedded in the crown and the folded leaf overlaps its base without a gap.
Neutral and grazing renders show broad waxy highlights, regional crimson-to-coral variation, cavity darkening, and restrained lenticels without plastic glare.
The normalized GLB preserves current physics/loading contracts and stays within a 4k-triangle mobile budget.

featureGroups.name: Five-lobed apple silhouette
qualityCriteria: Width is concentrated around the upper-middle body, the lower third narrows, and five restrained shoulder lobes remain readable without forming a pumpkin.
evidenceRefs: concept sheet side and top views
failureModes: body reads as a smooth sphere
radial lobes are deep enough to read as a pumpkin
bottom remains as wide as the shoulders

featureGroups.name: Crown cavity and five-point base
qualityCriteria: The crown cavity forms a real concave depression around the stem socket and the base ends in a shallow five-point indentation that remains stable on the physics floor.
failureModes: stem emerges from a flat cap
cavity is represented only by dark color
base is flat or terminates in a sharp unstable point

featureGroups.name: Embedded stem and folded leaf assembly
qualityCriteria: The thick curved stem overlaps the crown socket and the leaf overlaps the stem base with visible thickness, central fold, raised vein, and tapered curled tip.
evidenceRefs: hero upper center and upper right
failureModes: stem or leaf floats above the body
leaf reads as a flat oval
stem is a perfectly straight uniform cylinder

featureGroups.name: Waxy fruit skin without plastic glare
qualityCriteria: Crimson base, coral shoulder blush, burgundy cavity darkening, medium roughness variation, broad waxy highlight, and sparse low-contrast lenticels remain independently controllable.
Neutral and grazing light both preserve skin volume without a hard white hotspot.
failureModes: skin is one flat red albedo
speckles read as protruding beads or high-contrast dirt

featureGroups.name: Mobile game-camera readability and budget
qualityCriteria: Crown cavity, one leaf, body taper, and non-spherical silhouette survive the fixed near-top audit camera and icon downsampling.
The GLB stays normalized to maximum dimension 1.0, uses no floating decorative shells, and remains under 4k triangles.
failureModes: improvement appears only in a hero close-up
leaf or cavity disappears at game scale
extra detail exceeds the mobile triangle budget

visualDeltaChecks: old near-sphere silhouette versus new upper-heavy tapered silhouette
old shallow top dent versus new concave five-way crown cavity
old tiny straight stem/leaf versus new embedded curved stem and folded leaf
old flat red material versus crimson-coral-burgundy regional response
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.
Do not place adjacent separate-geometry parts below 0.02 world-unit seam overlap (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Do not satisfy raised or recessed relief, fasteners, or grip structure with a map alone when the feature affects form; use geometry or displacement (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).

authoringInstruction: Fill observed object class, complexity reasoning, featureGroups, visualDeltaChecks, and unknowns before generating or implementing ObjectSculptSpec.
